liebermann.notes: Mostly Ælfric's homilies and saints' lives and other Old English theology; in the same hand p. 339 Excommunication VII.

entries.text_de: Cambridge Corpus Christi College 3039, enthält zumeist Aelfric's Homilien und Heiligenleben, auch anderes Theologisches, Angelsächsisch, geschrieben um 1120; in ders. Hd. p. 339 Excom. VII, u. S. 438.
entries.text_en: Cambridge Corpus Christi College 3039, contains mostly Aelfric's homilies and saints' lives, also other theological material, in Anglo-Saxon, written c. 1120; in the same hand p. 339 Excom. VII, below, p. 438.

notes.text: Mostly Ælfric's homilies and saints' lives and other Old English theology; in the same hand p. 339 Excommunication VII.
